Your first pitch: what to expect

You get five minutes. The room listens, then asks questions for as long as the questions are useful. Nobody grades the deck: the point is to hear which parts of the story land and which ones raise doubts.

The same evening, you get written feedback from the people in the room. Most founders rewrite their opening after the first session, because the questions show which slide the room did not believe. Read the mistakes we see every week before you come.
